key_insight: RL-trained reasoners are best treated as complementary local experts, and a stronger student comes from expanding teacher coverage then compressing the teacher union rather than copying one “best” teacher.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a practical recipe for training single-model deployable systems with better reasoning quality by combining multi-teacher diversity, reliability gating, and distillation.
method: RGRPO: train successive teachers from the same initialization while redirecting later rounds toward uncovered examples.
TU-OPD: distill from the student’s own prefixes using only reliable teachers, weighted by per-example quality.
Consensus-Residual Decomposition: preserve a winner teacher’s extra token preferences so specialist behaviors survive aggregation.
evidence_signal: On math reasoning, code generation, and instruction following, the Qwen3-1.7B student outperformed the strongest individual teacher with relative gains of 2.0%, 8.3%, and 6.9% while keeping single-model inference.
watch_item: The approach depends on reliable teacher selection and quality weighting, so noisy teacher scoring or poor coverage tracking could weaken the union and reduce the benefit.
paper_title: Beyond the Best Teacher: Expanding and Compressing the Reasoning Solution Manifold
